# fallbackv1

```go
import fallbackv1 "pocketone.dev/ext/contracts/mail/fallback/v1"
```

Package fallbackv1 is the mail.fallback/v1 contract: where an app's mail goes when its SMTP is off. Providers form an ordered chain (\`providers: { mail.fallback/v1: \[mailtrap, mailrelay] }\` sets the order): each sends a message or passes it on with [ErrPass](#errpass); when every provider passes, PocketBase sends it its own way (sendmail).

Providers: mailtrap (dev mode: a local inbox), mailrelay (a multisite host's relay), or an app's own pb\_hooks. Each provider calls [Bind](#bind) when it registers; Bind owns the app's mail hook, once.

Source: [`ext/contracts/mail/fallback/v1`](https://github.com/pocketonehq/pocketone/tree/main/ext/contracts/mail/fallback/v1).

```go
var Contract = extkit.NewContract[Sender]("mail.fallback/v1", extkit.Many).JS(extkit.JSOpen, func(o *extkit.JSObject) Sender { return jsSender{o} }).JSTypes(jsTypes)
```

Contract is mail.fallback/v1.

<a id="errpass"></a>

```go
var ErrPass = errors.New("mail.fallback: passed")
```

ErrPass is a provider's "not mine": the next provider (or PocketBase) sends the message.

## Functions

### Bind

```go
func Bind(app core.App)
```

Bind makes app's mail go through mail.fallback/v1's providers whenever its SMTP is off. Providers call it in Register; it binds the hook once per app, last (the app's own onMailerSend hooks run, and may change the message, first).

## Types

### Sender

```go
type Sender interface {
	// Send delivers m, or returns ErrPass to leave it to the next provider.
	Send(ctx context.Context, m *mailer.Message) error
}
```

Sender delivers an app's mail when its SMTP is off.
